hero.title: Your Restaurant Website in 25+ Languages
hero.subtitle: Tourists and international guests see your menu in their own language. One tap to switch — everything adapts instantly: dishes, descriptions, contacts, navigation.
hero.noCreditCard: No credit card required. Free plan available.

features.title: How Multilingual Support Works
features.subtitle: Speak your customer's language without any extra work.

items.title: Guests Choose Their Language
items.description: A language selector appears on your menu. Guests tap their preferred language, and the entire website — menu, descriptions, contact info, navigation — switches instantly. No page reload needed.

items.title: Add Languages from Your Dashboard
items.description: Enable new languages with one click. Use AI translation to fill in the content, or enter translations manually. Each language can be toggled on or off independently.

howItWorks.title: How It Works
howItWorks.subtitle: Make your menu available in multiple languages in four steps.

steps.title: Go to Language Settings
steps.description: Open the Languages page in your dashboard. You'll see all available languages and which ones are currently active on your menu.

steps.title: Add Languages
steps.description: Select from 35 available languages. The free plan includes up to 2 languages, while Growth and Pro plans offer unlimited languages for your menu.

steps.title: Translate Your Content
steps.description: Use one-click AI translation to translate your entire menu instantly, or enter translations manually for full control. You can also combine both approaches.

steps.title: Guests Switch Languages
steps.description: A language selector appears on your menu page. When guests choose their language, the entire menu switches instantly. Their preference is saved for return visits.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.subtitle: Everything you need to know about multilingual menus.

items.question: How many languages can I add to my menu?
items.answer: Up to 35 languages including all major European languages, Chinese, Japanese, Korean, Arabic, Farsi, and more. Add as many as your guests need.

items.question: Do I need to translate everything manually?
items.answer: No. Use the built-in AI translation to translate your entire menu with one click. You can also edit any translation manually for full control.

items.question: Does the language preference get saved?
items.answer: Yes. When a guest selects a language, it's remembered for their next visit. They don't need to choose again when they return.

items.question: Is multilingual support available on the free plan?
items.answer: The free plan includes up to 2 languages. Growth and Pro plans offer unlimited languages with AI translation included.

items.question: Which languages support right-to-left text?
items.answer: Arabic and Farsi are fully supported with right-to-left (RTL) layout. The entire menu — text, navigation, and layout — automatically adjusts for RTL languages.

items.question: Can I translate table zones and reservation pages too?
items.answer: Yes. Translations apply to your entire restaurant website — menu items, categories, table zone names, and all public-facing pages. Everything your guests see is translatable.

items.question: How does the language selector work for guests?
items.answer: Guests see a language icon on your menu page. Tapping it shows all available languages. They select one and the entire menu switches immediately — no page reload needed.
